items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Tosseau used to have the band out of the Spanish Forge... He led the offing for 20, 25 years.

ctx.x: Armand Vesey, Emile Tosseau. So, when I was going to get to the, the Wood Crab Boys had a parade or something one day. And here I am up the line, blowing on my bugle, see? Yeah. And the kids all nicknamed me Tosseau. Tosseau used to have the band out of the Spanish Forge. Oh, that's right, I've heard of that.
